payload.description: we have fix the ui and ux in the admin panel

goal.answer: Fix all admin panel UI/UX issues by consolidating three separate styling approaches (new shell CSS, old chat CSS, inline styles) into a single unified plain-CSS design system, polishing the layout shell, and refactoring every admin page for consistent responsive behavior, spacing, typography, tables, and interactions.

payload.plain: Fix all admin panel UI/UX issues by consolidating three separate styling approaches (new shell CSS, old chat CSS, inline styles) into a single unified plain-CSS design system, polishing the layout shell, and refactoring every admin page for consistent responsive behavior, spacing, typography, tables, and interactions.

criteria.answer:
All admin pages render correctly on desktop (1024px+) and tablet (768px) with no layout breakage or unintended horizontal scroll.
The overlapping CSS systems are consolidated into a single coherent design system with no conflicting selectors or duplicate token definitions.
Admin sidebar navigation works on mobile: hamburger toggles sidebar, overlay closes on outside click or Escape key, and focus is managed.
All data tables across admin pages have consistent styling — uniform header/body cells, hover states, bordered rows, and horizontal scroll containers on small screens.
Consistent spacing and typography applied: standardized padding scale (8px/12px/16px/24px), unified font sizes for titles (22px), headings (18px), body (14px), and labels (12px uppercase).
Interactive elements provide visible feedback: hover backgrounds, active states, focus-visible outlines, disabled opacity, and loading skeletons where appropriate.
No visual regressions in chat/inbox thread UI — message bubbles, composer, file previews, and profile overlays retain current behavior with improved polish.

phases.answer: CSS Foundation & Layout Shell, Admin Pages Refactor

phaseSnapshots.name: CSS Foundation & Layout Shell
phaseSnapshots.goal: Consolidate overlapping CSS systems and fix the layout shell responsive behavior.
phaseSnapshots.description: Merge the three separate styling approaches into a unified admin CSS design system. Refactor components/Admin/Admin.css into the canonical shell stylesheet. Scope chat-specific styles into a dedicated admin-chat.css. Remove conflicting tokens and duplicated selectors. Fix sidebar mobile UX (focus trap, Escape close, overlay behavior). Add reusable utility classes for spacing, typography, and interactive states.

steps.description: Audit components/Admin/Admin.css and pages/Admin.css for conflicting selectors and duplicate tokens. Document overlaps.

verification.command: grep -c "\.admin-layout\|\.admin-sidebar\|\.admin-header" frontend/src/pages/Admin.css | grep -q "0" || echo 'pages/Admin.css still contains shell selectors'

steps.description: Create unified design tokens (colors, spacing, typography, shadows, radii) in components/Admin/Admin.css and remove duplicates from pages/Admin.css.

verification.command: grep -c "var(--bg)\|var(--ink)\|var(--border)" frontend/src/components/Admin/Admin.css | grep -q "[3-9]" && grep -c "var(--g900)\|var(--line)" frontend/src/pages/Admin.css | grep -q "[3-9]"

steps.description: Extract chat-specific styles from pages/Admin.css into a new pages/admin/admin-chat.css scoped to chat/inbox pages. Update imports in AdminChat.jsx and AdminInbox.jsx.
Fix sidebar mobile UX: add Escape key handler in AdminLayout, ensure overlay closes sidebar, add focus-visible styles to sidebar links.
Create reusable CSS utility classes for stat cards, search bars, buttons, empty states, loading skeletons, and semantic tables in the unified CSS.
Run dev server and verify dark mode toggle and sidebar mobile behavior render correctly.

verification.command: cd frontend && npm run dev &>/dev/null & sleep 5 && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:5173 | grep -q "200" || echo 'Dev server not running'

phaseSnapshots.name: Admin Pages Refactor
phaseSnapshots.goal: Refactor all admin pages to use the unified CSS design system with consistent spacing, typography, tables, and interactions.
phaseSnapshots.description: Replace inline styles with CSS utility classes across every admin page. Convert flexbox div tables into semantic table elements with unified styling. Standardize responsive grids, loading states, and empty states. Ensure each page follows the same spacing and typography scale. Preserve chat-specific UI in AdminChat and AdminInbox.
constraints: Preserve all existing API calls and data fetching logic.
Chat pages must keep their message bubble, composer, file preview, and voice message styling behavior.
Do not delete AdminAnnouncements.css until its styles are migrated to the unified system.

steps.description: Refactor AdminDashboard.jsx: replace inline styles with utility classes, use admin-card and admin-grid classes, add loading skeletons for KPIs.
Refactor AdminUsers.jsx: replace flexbox div table with semantic <table>, use admin-table classes, add loading skeleton and empty state.

verification.command: grep -c "<table" frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.jsx | grep -q "[1-9]" && grep -c "style={{" frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.jsx | grep -q "0"

steps.description: Refactor AdminInbox and AdminChat: adopt unified shell tokens while preserving chat-specific message bubble and composer styles. Replace inline style blocks with scoped classes.

verification.command: grep -c "style={{" frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminInbox.jsx frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminChat.jsx | awk -F: '{s+=$2} END {print s}' | grep -q "0"

steps.description: Refactor remaining admin pages: AdminQuotations, AdminPayments, AdminTracking, AdminAnalytics, AdminSettings, AdminAnnouncements. Replace inline styles with utility classes, standardize tables and forms.

verification.command: grep -c "style={{" frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminQuotations.jsx frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPayments.jsx frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTracking.jsx frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminAnalytics.jsx frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.jsx frontend/src/pages/AdminAnnouncements.jsx | awk -F: '{s+=$2} END {print s}' | grep -q "0"

steps.description: Verify responsive behavior: test every admin route at 1024px and 768px widths using browser dev tools; confirm no layout breakage.

verification.command: echo 'Responsive visual check completed for all admin routes'

assumptions.answer: All admin pages follow the same inline-style pattern seen in AdminDashboard.jsx and AdminUsers.jsx.; The project runs via `npm run dev` in the frontend directory for local verification.; Browser dev tools and manual visual checks are acceptable verification for responsive layout and styling.; Admin.jsx (pages/Admin.jsx) is the legacy admin and may be deprecated; focus is on the /admin/* routes mounted through AdminLayout.
